task: Add a compact in-page navigation bar to the existing MPE portfolio dashboard so smartphone users can jump directly to the weekly brief, P0, SUPPORT, HOLD, and New Idea Filter sections.
acceptance_criteria: The dashboard exposes visible links for the weekly brief, P0, SUPPORT, HOLD, and New Idea Filter sections.
Each link targets a unique existing section identifier and works without JavaScript.
The navigation remains horizontally usable on a narrow mobile viewport without widening the page.
Keyboard focus is visible and anchor targets are not hidden beneath the sticky navigation.
Package validation and the full unit-test suite pass.
non_scope: No dashboard data, project priority, progress percentage, or status change.
No JavaScript, backend, dependency, deployment, or Cloudflare configuration change.
No redesign of project cards or MPE architecture.

triage_input.summary: Add accessible mobile in-page navigation to the static MPE portfolio dashboard

pre_registered_human_label.rationale: This is a reversible, static, single-file navigation enhancement with explicit acceptance criteria, no data mutation, no dependency, and no architecture or deployment change.
